explanation: Two things about June 1950 follow from the Communist victory of 1949. Stalin consented to Kim Il-sung's attack only once the People's Republic existed and could be held out as a guarantor, and the Korean veterans of the Chinese armies went home to build his divisions. Then, when the United Nations force reached the Yalu in October, a Chinese state four months short of its first anniversary sent a million men across the river. Without the outcome of 1949 neither the decision to attack nor the intervention that saved the North has its condition.
